title: Enter brings back What’s new
summary:
Enter got a live-updating news banner and clearer announcements about model credits, Kimi K2.5 Thinking, and payment options.

Enter’s home and sign-in pages now show a banner with the three newest entries from the GitHub-hosted highlights file, replacing a disabled hard-coded banner.

The news copy says that, starting January 30, 2026, `claude-large`, `gemini-large`, `veo`, `seedream-pro`, and `nanobanana-pro` require purchased Pollen. Free daily credits remain available for other models. This PR updates the announcement, not model eligibility.

The highlights and README also announce Kimi K2.5 Thinking and PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay via Stripe. This PR adds those announcements, not the model or payment implementations.
